title: How to Build a Fitness App With AI (No Backend Setup Required)
summary: Build a fitness app with workout tracking, progress charts, and user profiles — no backend setup needed. Step-by-step guide using Blink's AI app builder.
body_markdown: Stripe is included in Blink — describe your pricing model in plain language and Blink generates the payment flow and access gates. The most common approach: a free tier with limited history plus a $9.99/month premium tier. You can also add a personal trainer account type that sells custom programs directly through your app.
